article.title: Why Weight Stabilization Does Not Fix a Lack of Positivity
article.why: Distinguish a variance-management technique from the positivity assumption required for causal identification.
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

sources.label: Background: causal inference and inverse probability weighting

paragraphs.en:
Inverse probability weighting can make observational groups more comparable, but the method depends on an important assumption: positivity. In simple terms, for every relevant combination of observed characteristics, there must be some chance of receiving treatment and some chance of not receiving it. If a certain type of customer is always treated, the data contain no untreated counterpart for that type. Weighting cannot create observations that do not exist.

This becomes important when analysts use stabilized weights. Ordinary inverse probability weights can become very large when a propensity score is close to zero or one. Stabilized weights modify the numerator so that the overall scale and variance of the weights are often more manageable. They can improve numerical behavior and may increase effective sample size compared with highly variable unstabilized weights. But stabilization does not repair structural non-overlap.

Suppose a campaign is automatically sent to every premium customer and never sent to standard customers. The estimated propensity score for premium customers will be near one, while the score for standard customers will be near zero. Multiplying the inverse probability weight by a treatment prevalence factor may make the numbers smaller, but it does not produce premium customers who were untreated or standard customers who were treated. The counterfactual comparison is still unsupported by observed data.

There is also a difference between practical and structural positivity problems. Structural positivity fails when treatment rules make one option impossible for a subgroup. Practical positivity problems occur when both options are theoretically possible but one is extremely rare in the available sample. More data may sometimes help with the practical case. It cannot solve a structural rule that assigns treatment deterministically.

Analysts should therefore inspect more than the final weight distribution. Plot propensity-score distributions by treatment group and look for common support. Examine minimum and maximum scores, extreme-weight percentiles, and effective sample size. Check whether business rules created deterministic assignment for particular segments. If overlap is weak, consider whether the estimand should be restricted to a population where both treatment states are realistically observed. Trimming or redefining the target population may be defensible, but those choices change the question being answered.

The key lesson is that stabilization and positivity operate at different levels. Stabilization changes how observed units contribute to an estimator; positivity concerns whether the data contain the comparisons needed to identify the effect at all. A smoother set of weights can make an estimate look more stable without making an impossible comparison valid. Before trusting a weighted causal estimate, ask two separate questions: Are the weights statistically well behaved? And do comparable treated and untreated observations actually exist across the population for which you want to make a causal claim?
paragraphs.zh:
逆機率加權可以讓觀察資料中的群組更可比，但它依賴一個重要假設：positivity。簡單說，在每一種重要的已觀測特徵組合下，都必須有人有機會接受 treatment，也有人有機會不接受。如果某類顧客永遠都被處置，資料中就沒有同類型的 untreated 對照；加權無法創造不存在的觀測。

這在使用 stabilized weights 時尤其容易被誤解。一般 inverse probability weight 在 propensity score 接近0或1時可能非常大。stabilized weight 透過調整分子，使權重整體尺度與變異通常更容易控制，也可能比高度變動的未穩定權重帶來較大的 effective sample size。但 stabilization 並不能修復結構性的 non-overlap。

假設活動自動寄給所有 premium customer，且從不寄給 standard customer。premium 的 propensity score 會接近1，standard 則接近0。即使把 inverse weight 乘上 treatment prevalence 讓數值變小，也不會因此產生「未被寄送的 premium」或「被寄送的 standard」。資料仍缺乏 counterfactual comparison。

還要區分 practical 與 structural positivity problem。Structural positivity failure 是由規則造成某子群根本不可能接受某種 treatment；practical positivity problem 則是兩種狀態理論上都可能，但樣本中其中一種極少。增加資料有時能改善 practical 問題，卻無法修復 deterministic assignment 的結構規則。

因此不能只看最終權重分布。應畫出 treatment/control 的 propensity-score distribution、檢查 common support、最小最大分數、極端權重 percentile、ESS，並確認商業規則是否讓特定 segment 被決定性分派。若 overlap 太弱，可以考慮把 estimand 限定在兩種 treatment state 都實際可觀測的母體。Trimming 或重新定義 target population 可能合理，但也會改變原本回答的問題。

核心是 stabilization 與 positivity 處理不同層次。Stabilization 改變已觀測單位對 estimator 的貢獻；positivity 則關係到資料是否根本包含識別效果所需的比較。權重變平順，不代表原本不可能的比較突然有效。信任 weighted causal estimate 前，要分別問：權重在統計上是否穩定？以及在想推論的母體中，真的存在可比較的 treated 與 untreated observations 嗎？
paragraphs.ja:
逆確率重み付けは観察データの群間比較を改善できますが、重要な仮定としてpositivityがあります。簡単に言えば、重要な観測属性の各組合せについて、treatmentを受ける可能性と受けない可能性の両方が必要です。ある顧客タイプが必ず処置されるなら、同タイプの未処置対照はデータに存在せず、weightingで存在しない観測を作ることはできません。

stabilized weightを使うとこの点が混同されやすくなります。通常のinverse probability weightはpropensity scoreが0や1に近いと非常に大きくなります。stabilized weightは分子を調整し、weight全体のスケールや分散を扱いやすくし、場合によってはeffective sample sizeも改善します。しかし構造的なnon-overlapを修復するものではありません。

たとえばpremium customer全員に自動配信し、standard customerには一切配信しない施策を考えます。premiumのpropensity scoreは1に近く、standardは0に近くなります。treatment prevalenceを使ってweightの数値を小さくしても、「未配信のpremium」や「配信されたstandard」が新たに生まれるわけではありません。counterfactual comparisonは依然として観測データに支えられていません。

practical positivityとstructural positivityも区別すべきです。Structural failureは業務ルールによってある選択肢が特定層で不可能な状態です。Practical problemは理論上は両方あり得るものの、サンプル内で一方が極端に少ない状態です。後者はデータ増加で改善する場合がありますが、deterministic assignmentのルールはデータを増やしても解決しません。

したがって最終weight分布だけでなく、処置群別のpropensity-score distribution、common support、最小最大値、極端weightのpercentile、ESSを確認し、業務ルールが特定segmentを決定的に割り付けていないかも調べます。overlapが弱い場合、両状態が現実に観測される母集団へestimandを限定する選択肢があります。ただしtrimmingやtarget populationの再定義は、答える問い自体を変えます。

要点は、stabilizationとpositivityは異なるレベルの問題だということです。Stabilizationは観測済み単位がestimatorへ与える寄与を変えますが、positivityは効果を識別する比較がそもそもデータに存在するかを問います。weightが滑らかになっても、不可能な比較が妥当になるわけではありません。weighted causal estimateを信頼する前に、「weightは統計的に安定しているか」と「推論対象母集団に比較可能なtreated/untreatedが本当に存在するか」を別々に確認する必要があります。

vocabulary.usage: Positivity requires both treatment possibilities within relevant covariate patterns.
A stabilized weight can reduce variability without creating overlap.
The counterfactual comparison may be unsupported.
Structural positivity failure cannot be fixed by more data.
A business rule may create deterministic assignment.
Inspect common support across treatment groups.
Restricting the population changes the estimand.
Treatment prevalence appears in stabilized-weight formulas.
Weak overlap makes causal comparisons fragile.
The data must support the comparisons needed to identify the effect.

quiz.question: Why do stabilized weights not solve structural positivity failure?
quiz.answer: They rescale contributions of observed units but cannot create missing treated or untreated counterparts.
